description: Generated tests that reach everything instead of sampling: every package, class and babel language, every mapped font, every primitive with probes and error paths, a seeded differential fuzzer, and scaling stress cases. Regenerate with tests/corpus/gen/all.py; the documents live in target/corpus/gen/ and are not committed. An oracle failure on these entries is itself a test (judge_failure): the candidate must fail with the same log.

exclusions.what: 193 .sty names and 12 .cls names found only outside tex/latex and tex/generic (tex/latex-dev, tex/lualatex, tex/luatex, tex/xelatex, tex/xetex, tex/plain, tex/amstex)
exclusions.why: They belong to other engines or to the development kernel. rstex targets pdfTeX and the release kernel; the task named tex/latex and tex/generic.
They are language helpers of other packages (datatool, datetime2, ...), not babel languages. Most are read by those packages when loaded.

exclusions.what: font expansion and protrusion run on a sample of 88 of 4361 mapped fonts (every 25th that loads and has a font file)
exclusions.why: The paragraph machinery is common code; the sample exercises it across formats and encodings. Every mapped font still gets its full table.

exclusions.what: 2155 map entries have no .tfm in this TeX Live; their table runs on a stub .tfm (a copy of ecrm1000.tfm) in the document directory
exclusions.why: Without metrics TeX cannot load them. The real path is tested too: notfm documents must fail with the same message on every font. 127 of them also have no font file or encoding and are fatal on the oracle.

exclusions.what: 6 map entries with a .tfm are fatal on the oracle because a .pfb or .enc is missing; each is alone in its document
exclusions.why: The candidate must die with the same message; these fonts have no table to compare.

exclusions.what: 14 encTeX and MLTeX primitives (charsubdef, charsubdefmax, charsubdefmin, endmubyte, mubyte, mubytein, mubytelog, mubyteout, noconvert, specialout, tracingcharsubdef, xchrcode, xordcode, xprncode) are tested only as undefined
exclusions.why: They exist only with -enc or -mltex. DESIGN section 3 drops those modes, so the -enc and -mltex paths are not run.

exclusions.what: 52 primitives have no bare-use document: chardef countdef def dimendef dump edef end endinput errorstopmode font futurelet gdef global if ifcase ifcat ifcsname ifdefined ifdim ifeof iffalse iffontchar ifhbox ifhmode ifincsname ifinner ifmmode ifnum ifodd ifpdfabsdim ifpdfabsnum ifpdfprimitive iftrue ifvbox ifvmode ifvoid ifx input let letterspacefont long mathchardef muskipdef outer partokenname pdfcopyfont protected read readline skipdef toksdef xdef
exclusions.why: A bare use would swallow the rest of the document or end the job. Their probes and prim-fatal entries cover the same paths.

exclusions.what: 3 primitives have no hand-written probe in their main document (dump, end, errorstopmode)
exclusions.why: They end the job, so they are only in prim-fatal and prim-ini.

exclusions.what: \everyjob at format load is reached only through the system formats; \dump output is judged by its log and by the .fmt existing
exclusions.why: rstex lays out its format differently (DESIGN sections 4 and 7), so .fmt bytes do not compare. A format cannot be loaded across engines.

exclusions.what: dropped or deferred features keep entries that a candidate without them cannot pass: coverage/prim-image/png and pdf (deferred), letterspacefont (needs VF), pdfmapline-removed and unmapped-font-pk (PK, Type 3), pdfmapline-ttf and pdfmapline-otf (TrueType, OTF), synctex
exclusions.why: DESIGN section 3. They stay in the denominator, so the count states what is missing instead of hiding it.
A budget, not a limit: tests/corpus/gen/all.py --seeds N runs more. Failing cases shrink with tests/corpus/gen/shrink.py.

exclusions.what: the capacity-* stress entries compare a limit from texmf.cnf, not a typesetting result
exclusions.why: A candidate with a growable memory (DESIGN section 4) is expected to differ on capacity-main-memory, capacity-hash and capacity-save-stack. They stay in the denominator and in every report. Grouping levels, the input stack and the expansion depth are limits documents can see.
